onscreen_lines.desc: Site Preparation. This item shall include all items necessary for the preparation of the construction site. Measurement for Site Preparation shall be made on a lump sum basis. Payment for Site Preparation shall be made at the unit price bid per lump sum and shall be full compensation for the items listed in NCTCOG Item 203.1, which includes the removal and disposal of trash and debris in the operations area, No Clearing, tree removal or excavation is allowed except within the pond area. Topsoil and Sodding shall be in accordance with City of Plano Turfgrass Planting specification. It is the intent of NCTCOG Item 203.1 to provide for the removal and disposal of all obstructions and objectionable materials not specifically provided for elsewhere in the plans and specifications. This item shall also include all labor, materials, equipment, tools, and incidentals necessary for H Avenue and sidewalk protection, which shall be maintained for the duration of the project.

Temporary Chain Link Fence. This work includes the labor, equipment, and material required to construct temporary 6 ft tall chain link fence with fabric including necessary steel posts, hinges, and fasteners at the location approved by the engineer. Measurement and payment for work performed and materials furnished related to the 6 ft temporary chain link fence with fabric shall be made on the basis of price per linear foot and shall be total compensation for furnishing and/or operating all labor, materials, tools, equipment, and other incidentals necessary to complete the work.

onscreen_lines.desc: Sediment Removal: This item shall include the dewatering of the pond operations to perform the project as described in the plans. This is to include the removal of approximately 576.4 yrds and the equipment associated with Removing and disposal of the material. Payout is not based on volumetric amount of material removed. Payment Performance is based on the contractors success at removal of material to achieve proposed contours +/- 6". It is the contractors responsibility to perform their own field verification of bathymetric and sediment thickness. This is to include but not be limited to all materials within in the pond Structure: (tree limbs, trash and debris, gravels and broken concrete). “Dewatering operations shall be conducted using a screened pump. The contractor shall monitor the discharge to the storm sewer system at least once per day, and more frequently if necessary, to ensure that discharge does not contain suspended silt or sediment that may later settle and affect the capacity of the storm sewer system.”

Material Disposal: This item shall include the disposal of approximately 576.4 yrds of material removed from the pond and hauled off to disposal location. All sediment removed from the ponds shall be disposed of at an appropriate off-site facility. A list of pre-authorized disposal locations can be found in the bid- packet. Contractor is responsible for any additional testing of materials prior to disposal as required by disposal location.A disposal route shall be prepared and submitted to the City Project Manager prior to comencement of work. All corresponding Trucking Tickets/Manifest as well as disposal location weigh tickets, are to be submitted to the City Project Manager on a weekly basis.
